explanation: I searched Mathlib/FieldTheory (Finite, Galois) for a statement that every ring automorphism of GF(4), or of a field of characteristic 2 with 4 elements, is an involution. I found nothing direct. The closest results are `IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank` and `orderOf_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic`. Getting the theorem from them would take real work. You would have to turn σ into an algebra automorphism over ZMod 2, identify the field with GaloisField 2 2, and use the order of the Frobenius or the size of the group. That is more than one or two short lines, so I did not count it as a special case.
